name: Kiryuu Tsukasa
source:
Tsukasa is a second year student in the same class as Jun'ichi, and is his childhood friend. She is a member of the News club. She has a lively personality and loves to gossip as well as tease Jun'ichi.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akane_Iro_ni_Somaru_Saka]Wikipedia[/url].]
